name: WdTextboxTightWrap
description: Specifies how Microsoft Word tightly wraps text around text boxes.

constants.name: wdTightNone
constants.description: Does not wrap text tightly around the contents of a text box.

constants.name: wdTightAll
constants.description: Wraps text around the text box tightly to the contents of the text box on all lines.

constants.name: wdTightFirstAndLastLines
constants.description: Wraps text tightly only on first and last lines.

constants.name: wdTightFirstLineOnly
constants.description: Wraps text tightly only on the first line.

constants.name: wdTightLastLineOnly
constants.description: Wraps text tightly only on the last line.
